plugins.name: WorkBuddy
plugins.description: Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) OAuth provider for CLIProxyAPI: multi-account login, dynamic models, chat executor, CN daily check-in, Global one-shot expert trial (manual), credit lifecycle (disable CN / delete Global when exhausted), credits panel with CN/Global filters, optional credits-aware scheduler.
plugins.author: Sliverkiss

plugins.name: QwenWork
plugins.description: QwenWorkCN (千问办公, gateway.qwenwork.cn) provider for CLIProxyAPI: login by converting the desktop client's auth-v2.dat into a plugin auth file (tools/make_auth.py; OAuth device authorization returns 400 and PAT endpoints 404 on this gateway), COSY-signed chat executor, dynamic model list, daily check-in with credit snapshot, token keepalive (deviceToken/jobToken prefix-routed, PAT fallback), accounts panel.
plugins.author: Sliverkiss
